_comment: Defaults for a fresh board. Anything saved in Settings overrides what's here, per browser. Treat this file as the template everyone starts from - if you put your own dates in it and the repository is public, you have published them.
title: Countdown

target._comment: Today doesn't count, the target does - so on the day itself the board reads zero.
target.label: until

_counters_comment: type is one of: working, calendar, weekday, next-date, next-range, date. tier is primary, secondary or minor, and picks the flap size. The vest and time-off counters ship empty so they're discoverable - fill them in from Settings, or delete them.
